reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because it primarily provides an instructional walkthrough of buying, selling, funding, security, fees, and account limits on Coinbase. It promotes a Coinbase referral bonus and links to additional crypto services, but it does not present a guaranteed profit claim or establish a deceptive money or data-collection mechanism. The stated risk disclaimer and discussion of fees and transaction procedures are consistent with ordinary platform promotion and tutorial content.

opening.argument: The solicitation is explicit: viewers are directed to use the speaker's link and make a first payment to receive $10. That is a low-barrier cash reward tied directly to registration and depositing money, rather than merely general education. The description repeats the same condition and supplies a referral URL, creating a concrete action-to-reward funnel. The offer therefore deserves scrutiny as a promised monetary benefit attached to a viewer's financial action.

rebuttal.rebuttal: Calling the bonus ancillary does not remove the solicitation: the speaker personally asks viewers to use the link and ties the reward to an initial payment. The reference's description of a tutorial also leaves unanswered whether viewers are being steered into a financially consequential promotion. Discussion of fees and procedures may make the offer appear more credible, but does not establish that the promised reward is harmless or adequately explained.

opening.argument: Several concrete risk signals appear together: a cash bonus, an external referral link, cryptocurrency purchasing, bank and card funding, and submission of identity documents. The promised reward is conditioned on putting money into the platform, while the account process requires a passport photograph. Even if each element can occur in legitimate commerce, their combination creates a low-friction acquisition pitch in which money and sensitive data flow toward a crypto service for a relatively small promised reward.
